findings.comment: Buildings do not maintain documented minimum 7 feet 6 inches horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric conductors. No building elevation sheets with surveyed conductor elevations or clearance dimension annotations provided to verify compliance with required 7.5-foot clearance.

Surveyed elevations and locations of overhead conductors not included on building elevation sheets. No elevation drawings provided showing overhead conductor locations or surveyed elevation data by registered surveyor required to demonstrate building clearance compliance.

applicableAreas: Electrical plan and building section views
findings.comment: Section and plan view exhibits do not show dimensions from outer electric conductor to outermost edge of buildings and building projections for clearance verification. Preliminary Electrical Design Plan shows no clearance dimension lines from conductors to building edges, only underground electrical routing without surveyed overhead conductor locations or clearance annotations.

applicableAreas: All electrical clearance dimensions on site plans
findings.comment: Clearance dimensions measured from utility pole or centerline cannot be verified; no clearance dimension annotations shown on any plan sheets. Plans must show dimension lines originating at outside conductor location, not pole centerline or pole structure, to verify compliance with code requirement that measurements originate from actual electric wire, not pole center.

applicableAreas: Areas where driveways and parking areas are proposed beneath overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Survey by registered surveyor showing pole locations and mid-span clearances not provided. Overhead electric lines exist at site perimeter; no surveyed overhead conductor elevation data or mid-span clearance verification provided for driveways and parking areas that may be beneath or adjacent to overhead lines.

applicableAreas: Landscape plan areas within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors (eastern and southern property boundaries)
findings.comment: Trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors are not verified as Utility Compatible Shade Trees from ECM Appendix F list. Landscape Plan shows proposed mitigation trees (marked M) located directly adjacent to or within 10 feet of overhead electric lines (OHE) along southern and eastern property boundaries; no tree species identification provided for proposed plantings to verify utility compatibility designation (mature height ≤20 feet).

codeCitations: Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003
applicableAreas: Cover sheet general notes, construction sequence
findings.comment: Plans do not include required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines. This mandatory note is absent from cover sheet and general notes despite presence of overhead electric transmission and distribution facilities on or adjacent to site.
